output_list.code: function mint(address receiver, uint amount) public {
output_list.reason: The mint function is used to mint new tokens for the receiver. However, the function does not check if the receiver has enough balance to receive the minted tokens. If the receiver has a balance of 0, the mint function will mint the tokens to the receiver and the receiver will not be able to transfer the tokens out of the contract. This will devalue the token and make the tokens unusable.
